title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go, parity fixes, v1.60.0 bump
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: unify SDK ergonomics for authentication, retry/backoff, and streaming APIs across Python, TypeScript, and Go to reduce maintenance surface, improve parity, and unblock downstream integrations. This PR bundles: 1) unified auth surface (credential providers + token refresh hooks) for all SDKs, 2) standardized retry policy and default backoff config with pluggable hooks, 3) streaming API parity (server->client streaming and resumable client streams), 4) ergonomic surface adjustments to align naming and signatures across languages, 5) a coordinated version bump to v1.60.0 with changelog entries. Implementation notes: - Introduces a small shim package in each SDK to expose a common interface (AuthProvider, RetryPolicy, StreamClient) while keeping native idiomatic wrappers. - Token refresh is now automatic with a configurable refresh_threshold and an explicit refresh hook for edge cases. - Retry policy is centralized and exposes max_attempts/initial_backoff/max_backoff/jitter_strategy. Default is conservative to avoid doubling downstream cost. - Streaming surface adds a unified onMessage/onError/onComplete callback model (TS/Py) and a channel-based pattern for Go. - Parity: fixed a couple of parameter mismatches (content_type vs mediaType, async iterator vs callback naming) that caused subtle client bugs. Testing & CI: comprehensive unit/test-suite updates for all languages; interoperability tests added to redwood-sdk-integration that run simple multi-lang streaming flows. Migration notes: non-breaking for most users; some method renames have thin shims for backward compatibility but will warn for two releases. See release_notes below. Linear/Jira: tracked under ENG-8765 and ENG-9102. Checklist: [x] spec & design doc updated, [x] unit tests, [x] e2e integration tests, [x] docs/changelog, [x] SDK package release notes. Merge: squash merge after approvals and green CI.
commits: feat(sdk): add common AuthProvider interface and shim across py/ts/go
feat(sdk): implement token auto-refresh with refresh_threshold and hook
feat(sdk): introduce RetryPolicy config + default exponential backoff
fix(sdk): streaming parity - unify event names and payload shape
refactor(sdk): rename example methods for ergonomic parity
test(sdk): add multi-lang streaming integration tests
docs(sdk): update quickstarts and changelog for v1.60.0
chore: bump sdk versions to v1.60.0
fix(python): preserve legacy sync iterator shim with deprecation warning
ci: add matrix job for sdk interop tests
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Left a few nits on naming and asked for clarity on the deprecation warning window. Requested tests for token refresh race conditions.
Asha Patel: Responded that deprecation warnings will be logged for two releases (v1.60.x and v1.61.x) and added explicit env var to opt-out. Added unit tests for concurrent refreshes.
Leah Kim: Asked to tighten default retry settings for low-QPS serverless use; proposed initial_backoff reduce from 500ms to 250ms. Suggested exposing JitterStrategy as an enum.
Asha Patel: Agreed and updated defaults to 250ms initial backoff for low-QPS; exposed jitter_strategy enum across languages.
Connor O'Neill: Verified Go channel-based stream behavior and suggested a small improvement to the stream close path to avoid goroutine leaks. Patch applied.
Miguel Torres: Approved after CI green and integration tests passing.
release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) unified auth and retry ergonomics; automatic token refresh added with refresh_threshold.
- Streaming API parity across languages: unified callback/iterator patterns and improved resumability.
- Several non-breaking renames with backward-compatible shims (deprecated for two releases).
- Default retry policy tightened for low-QPS environments.
- Bumped SDK versions to v1.60.0.
